description: Aménagement cyclable is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Dictionnaire Public Ce jeu de données représente sous forme de tronçons linéaires les aménagements cyclables permettant la pratique du vélo sur le territoire de Bordeaux Métropole. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. Its keywords are voirie, cyclables, vélo, tronçons, aménagement, pistes. The portal shows 29,173 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
